entities.summary: Mikola Aliaksandravich Dziadok is a Belarusian journalist, anarchist activist, blogger, and former political prisoner. He was released in 2015 and became in involved in the 2020 Belarusian protests. He was arrested by authorities again and was sentenced to five years in a general-security penal colony on November 10, 2021. Dziadok was released from prison and de-facto deported to Lithuania in September 2025.
